Environ 10 % des participants trouvaient: About 10% of participants found the right answer. Presented as an age check in a bar, the same task becomes easy for most people.
Les cartes de Wason, que 10 % des gens s: Wason's cards, which 10% of people know how to turn over. I turn over the right ones, and one of your board's squares with them.
Avec des lettres et des nombres, presque: With letters and numbers, almost nobody turns over the right cards. With drinks and ages in a bar, most people succeed.
Une roue truquée qui ne s'arrête que sur: A rigged wheel that only stops on 10 or 65, and estimates that dutifully follow the number drawn.
La roue truquée de Tversky et Kahneman,: Tversky and Kahneman's rigged wheel, which only lands on 10 or 65. I spin it: 65. Thought you'd move that far? Anchoring. You move back one square.
Des participants qui ont vu la roue s'ar: Participants who saw the wheel stop on 10 estimated the share of African countries in the UN at 25% on average; those who saw 65, at 45%.
